query:
INSERT INTO quickfireQuestions
  (type, question, reviewAnswer, echoCategory, category, difficulty, isActive, submissionStatus)
VALUES
('quickReview','What is the normal testicular size?','3–5 cm length, 2–3 cm AP/width; volume ~15–25 mL','scrotum','Scrotum','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal testicular echogenicity?','Homogeneous, medium-level echogenicity; bilateral symmetry','scrotum','Scrotum','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the sonographic appearance of testicular torsion?','Enlarged, hypoechoic testis with absent Doppler flow; epididymis may be enlarged','scrotum','Scrotum','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the most common testicular malignancy?','Seminoma (most common germ cell tumor in males 25–45 years)','scrotum','Scrotum','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the sonographic appearance of a seminoma?','Homogeneous, hypoechoic intratesticular mass with increased vascularity','scrotum','Scrotum','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the sonographic appearance of a testicular cyst?','Anechoic, thin-walled, posterior acoustic enhancement — benign','scrotum','Scrotum','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is a varicocele and how is it identified on ultrasound?','Dilated pampiniform plexus veins >3 mm; increases with Valsalva; left side more common','scrotum','Scrotum','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the sonographic appearance of epididymo-orchitis?','Enlarged, hyperechoic epididymis with increased Doppler flow; may involve testis','scrotum','Scrotum','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is a hydrocele?','Anechoic fluid collection between the tunica vaginalis layers — most common scrotal mass','scrotum','Scrotum','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is a spermatocele?','Anechoic or hypoechoic cyst in the epididymis head — contains spermatozoa','scrotum','Scrotum','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the sonographic appearance of a testicular microlithiasis?','Multiple tiny echogenic foci (<3 mm) without shadowing scattered throughout the testis','scrotum','Scrotum','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal epididymis head size?','5–12 mm; body and tail are thinner (2–4 mm)','scrotum','Scrotum','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the bell-clapper deformity?','Abnormal high attachment of the tunica vaginalis — predisposes to testicular torsion','scrotum','Scrotum','advanced',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the whirlpool sign in testicular torsion?','Twisting of the spermatic cord on color Doppler — confirms torsion','scrotum','Scrotum','advanced',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the ACR BI-RADS classification system?','Breast Imaging Reporting and Data System — standardized reporting for breast ultrasound (categories 0–6)','breast','Breast','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the BI-RADS 3 recommendation?','Probably benign — short-interval follow-up in 6 months','breast','Breast','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the BI-RADS 4 recommendation?','Suspicious — tissue sampling (biopsy) recommended','breast','Breast','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the BI-RADS 5 recommendation?','Highly suggestive of malignancy — biopsy required','breast','Breast','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What sonographic features suggest a benign breast cyst?','Anechoic, circumscribed, oval/round, thin walls, posterior acoustic enhancement','breast','Breast','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What sonographic features suggest breast malignancy?','Irregular shape, non-parallel (taller-than-wide), spiculated margins, hypoechoic, posterior shadowing, vascularity','breast','Breast','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the sonographic appearance of a fibroadenoma?','Oval, circumscribed, parallel orientation, homogeneous hypoechoic, gentle lobulations','breast','Breast','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the taller-than-wide sign in breast ultrasound?','AP diameter > transverse diameter — associated with malignancy (non-parallel orientation)','breast','Breast','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal breast tissue echogenicity?','Heterogeneous mix of echogenic fat, fibroglandular tissue, and Cooper ligaments','breast','Breast','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the sonographic appearance of invasive ductal carcinoma?','Hypoechoic, irregular, spiculated, taller-than-wide, posterior shadowing, internal vascularity','breast','Breast','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is a complicated cyst on breast ultrasound?','Cyst with internal echoes (debris, septations) — BI-RADS 3 if no solid component','breast','Breast','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal axillary lymph node appearance?','Oval, thin cortex (<3 mm), echogenic fatty hilum, hilar vascularity','breast','Breast','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What lymph node features suggest malignancy?','Cortical thickening >3 mm, loss of fatty hilum, round shape, peripheral vascularity','breast','Breast','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the ACR BI-RADS 6 category?','Known biopsy-proven malignancy — prior to definitive treatment','breast','Breast','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal rotator cuff tendon echogenicity?','Hyperechoic, fibrillar echotexture with parallel fibers','msk','MSK','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is anisotropy in MSK ultrasound?','Artificial hypoechogenicity of a tendon when the beam is not perpendicular to the tendon fibers','msk','MSK','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the sonographic appearance of a full-thickness rotator cuff tear?','Non-visualization of tendon, fluid-filled defect, cortical irregularity of the greater tuberosity','msk','MSK','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the sonographic appearance of tendinosis?','Tendon thickening, hypoechogenicity, loss of fibrillar pattern — no acute inflammation','msk','MSK','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the sonographic appearance of a partial-thickness rotator cuff tear?','Focal hypoechoic or anechoic defect involving part of the tendon thickness','msk','MSK','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal supraspinatus tendon thickness?','5–7 mm (measured in the sagittal plane at the critical zone)','msk','MSK','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the carpal tunnel on ultrasound?','Fibro-osseous tunnel at the wrist containing the median nerve and flexor tendons','msk','MSK','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal cross-sectional area (CSA) of the median nerve at the carpal tunnel?','<10 mm² (>10–12 mm² suggests carpal tunnel syndrome)','msk','MSK','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the sonographic appearance of a ganglion cyst?','Anechoic or hypoechoic, lobulated, thin-walled cyst adjacent to a joint or tendon sheath','msk','MSK','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal patellar tendon thickness?','3–6 mm (thickening >7 mm suggests tendinopathy)','msk','MSK','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the sonographic appearance of plantar fasciitis?','Thickened plantar fascia >4 mm at the calcaneal insertion, hypoechoic, loss of fibrillar pattern','msk','MSK','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the dynamic assessment of the shoulder on MSK ultrasound?','Impingement testing — abduction/internal rotation to observe subacromial bursa and rotator cuff','msk','MSK','advanced',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal Achilles tendon thickness?','4–6 mm (thickening >7 mm suggests tendinopathy)','msk','MSK','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the sonographic appearance of a muscle tear?','Hypoechoic or anechoic hematoma within the muscle, disruption of fibrillar pattern','msk','MSK','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal nerve appearance on MSK ultrasound?','Honeycomb pattern — hypoechoic fascicles surrounded by hyperechoic epineurium','msk','MSK','beginner',1,'draft')
